notes.title: Patch 1 is live
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p]Patch 1 for Part One is now live!
This update includes:[/p][list][*][p]French language support[/p][/*][*][p]Improved writing and corrected spelling in the English version[/p][/*][*][p]Several bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Enjoy the game and stay tuned for more updates.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1 arrives soon
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dear Players,[/b][/p][p]First of all, thank you for playing [i]Innocent Au-pair[/i]! I hope you’ve enjoyed the game so far, even though I understand that not everyone was pleased with some of the changes from previous builds (for those who played them).[/p][p]By the end of this week (around [b]20 July[/b]), [b]Patch 1[/b] for [i]Part One[/i] will arrive. This update will include:[/p][list][*][p]One missing scene that will now be added.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected spellings in the English version.[/p][/*][*][p][b]French language support.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]A significant portion of our players are from France, and I feel the game deserves proper French support.
Please note that support for different languages has been achieved with the help of AI. The quality is well above average, but there may still be some minor mistakes. Once Part Two is completed, all languages will undergo professional proofreading.[/p][p]As for [b]Part Two[/b], the plan is to have it ready by the end of the year. I’ll keep you updated as we go along. To be clear: [b]once you purchase the game, you will not need to pay again for updates.[/b] All future updates will be delivered automatically.[/p][p]When smaller portions of Part Two are ready, I’ll share them on Patreon, and the plan is to release slightly larger updates on Steam as progress continues. In one way or another, Steam players will receive all updates as well.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned![/b][/p][p][/p]
